title: Lycurgus competes in the Iphitus Games
summary: Lycurgus of Sparta competes in the games of Iphitus at Elis, the second recorded Olympic-type games.
description: Lycurgus of Sparta competes in the games of Iphitus at Elis, the second recorded Olympic-type games. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 3 (Table 2, row c. 884, p. 46).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 3): c. 884 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 3: The Founding Dates of Tyre and Carthage," OSF preprint v1.2 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9V65S, Table 2, row c. 884, p. 46
chronologies.note: He lived decades past the Iphitus Games. Eratosthenes: 108 years before the first Olympiad.
